panels.title: Unconsumed messages by stream / consumer
panels.description: JetStream consumer num_pending from the NATS server; this is broker state, not outbox/import database state. Multiple geodata replicas are collapsed with max so a broker count is not multiplied.

panels.title: Messages awaiting acknowledgement
panels.description: Messages already delivered to a consumer but not yet acknowledged. Multiple geodata replicas are collapsed with max.

panels.title: Redelivered message count
panels.description: Current cumulative JetStream consumer redelivery count reported by the broker. This is a gauge because it is sampled from ConsumerInfo and may reset when a consumer is recreated. Replicas are collapsed with max.

panels.title: Oldest outstanding message age
panels.description: Age of the oldest unacknowledged or not-yet-delivered message, estimated using the consumer sequence floor and the stored message timestamp. Check the availability panel if a purged sequence prevented measurement. Replicas are collapsed with max.

targets.expr: max by (stream, consumer) (myota_jetstream_consumer_oldest_message_age_seconds{job="myota-otel-collector"} and on (stream, consumer) (myota_jetstream_consumer_oldest_message_age_available{job="myota-otel-collector"} == 1))

panels.title: Consumer metrics pollers healthy
panels.description: One means every geodata replica successfully polled all configured JetStream streams during its latest interval.

panels.title: Oldest-age measurements unavailable
panels.description: Consumer series where the broker sequence could not be read, commonly because retention purged that message between the consumer-info and message-get requests. Consumer duplicates from geodata replicas are deduplicated.

panels.title: Dedicated PostGIS bounding-box query time (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: SQL execution time recorded around the actual indexed ST_Intersects bounding-box query. This complements API route latency and can be correlated with the separate EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) evidence report.

panels.title: Slow PostGIS bounding-box queries
panels.description: Count of geodata bounding-box queries exceeding MYOTA_SLOW_QUERY_THRESHOLD_MS.

title: MyOTA JetStream backlog and PostGIS query performance
